# SurgeAI

> SurgeAI is a public catalog of apps and games distributed through GitHub Releases.

## Resources

- [SurgeAI website](https://surgeai.si/): Browse the app and game catalog.
- [App and game catalog](https://surgeai.si/catalog.json): Static JSON catalog with release download URLs.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EmperorAsy/surgeai/releases): Download published app and game files.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/EmperorAsy/surgeai): Website source and publishing instructions.
